evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Scientific image-analysis workflows require agents to select among diverse capabilities like description, detection, counting, and segmentation.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evaluation on a zero-shot benchmark of 51 scientific-intent queries shows that explicit routing semantics can substantially improve routing accuracy, particularly at semantically adjacent action boundaries, although improvements vary across models.
